new_candidates.body:
### Describe the bug

The MJCF and URDF importers of Isaac Sim 6.2 author mesh colliders inside USD instances (`payloads/instances.usda`). `spawn_from_usd_file` then applies the cfg's schema properties, but the writers skip instance proxies, so properties that target colliders, such as `collision_props`, reach the primitive colliders only. `UsdFileCfg.make_uninstanceable` exists for this case, but `MjcfFileCfg` and `UrdfFileCfg` do not have it, and the converters' `make_instanceable` is not used by either importer.

### Steps to reproduce

```python
from isaaclab.app import AppLauncher

app = AppLauncher(headless=True).app

import tempfile

from isaaclab_physx.sim.schemas import PhysxCollisionCfg
from pxr import Usd, UsdPhysics

import isaaclab.sim as sim_utils

tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
with open(f"{tmp}/tetra.obj", "w") as f:
    f.write("v 0 0 0\nv 0.1 0 0\nv 0 0.1 0\nv 0 0 0.1\nf 1 3 2\nf 1 2 4\nf 1 4 3\nf 2 3 4\n")
with open(f"{tmp}/robot.xml", "w") as f:
    f.write(
        '<mujoco><asset><mesh file="tetra.obj"/></asset><worldbody><body name="base"><freejoint/>'
        '<geom name="box" type="box" size="0.05 0.05 0.05"/><geom name="mesh" type="mesh" mesh="tetra"/>'
        "</body></worldbody></mujoco>"
    )

sim_utils.create_new_stage()
cfg = sim_utils.MjcfFileCfg(
    asset_path=f"{tmp}/robot.xml", usd_dir=f"{tmp}/usd", collision_props=PhysxCollisionCfg(contact_offset=0.0123)
)
prim = cfg.func("/World/Robot", cfg)
for p in Usd.PrimRange(prim, Usd.TraverseInstanceProxies()):
    if p.HasAPI(UsdPhysics.CollisionAPI):
        print(p.GetPath(), "instance proxy:", p.IsInstanceProxy(), "contact offset:", p.GetAttribute("physxCollision:contactOffset").Get())

app.close()
```

```
[Warning] [isaaclab.sim.schemas.schemas] Skipping fragment updates on instanced prims matched by '/World/Robot(/.*)?': ['/World/Robot/Geometry/base/mesh/mesh'].
/World/Robot/Geometry/base/box instance proxy: False contact offset: 0.012299999594688416
/World/Robot/Geometry/base/mesh/mesh instance proxy: True contact offset: None
```

A URDF with a mesh `<collision>` spawned through `UrdfFileCfg` gives the same result.

### System Info

- Commit: `main` @ `b3ef9ce18e`; `v3.0.0` has the same code
- Isaac Sim Version: 6.2.0
- OS: Ubuntu 24.04
- GPU: NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell
- CUDA: 13.0
- GPU Driver: 580.126.20

### Additional context

Moving `make_uninstanceable` from `UsdFileCfg` to `FileCfg` and applying it for every file spawner before the property writes fixes both: with `make_uninstanceable=True` the mesh collider above gets the contact offset.

### Checklist

- [x] I have checked that there is no similar issue in the repo (**required**)
- [x] I have checked that the issue is not in running Isaac Sim itself and is related to the repo

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `MjcfFileCfg` and `UrdfFileCfg` can apply spawn-time properties to the colliders that the importers author inside instances.
